summary: Full backend + frontend testing of the revamped /crm page (iteration 22). All 5 backend endpoints (clients/overview, POST /clients with new fields, PATCH /clients/{id}/quick, POST /ai/parse-contact, POST /ai/tidy-notes, DELETE /clients/{id}) passed pytest (5/5). Frontend Playwright end-to-end: PIN 033003 -> /crm loads with crm-page + quick-capture + filters (all/contact/quote_sent/signed/invoiced/lost) + counts + clients-grid. Quick-capture: text 'TEST_CRM Martin 06 11 22 33 44 Dole toiture 80m2 rappeler demain' -> Gemini returned draft-name='Martin', draft-phone='06 11 22 33 44', draft-city='Dole' in ~5s. Save -> toast + client-sheet auto-opened + card appeared. sheet-notes edit -> 2s later persisted (verified via GET /api/clients/overview -> notes contains 'test-note-autosave'). sheet-callback set to today -> reminders-strip appeared with reminder-{id} button. sheet-tidy-notes reorganized in ~10s to sections CHANTIER/PAIEMENT/RDV with '•' bullets. sheet-new-quote navigated to /quotes/new with TEST_ client prefilled. Filter invoiced shows 14 cards; search 'TEST_' filters to 1 card. Cleanup: DELETE /api/clients/{id} status 200 confirmed. Mobile 390x844: quick-capture usable, grid=1 col (cards not on same row), client-sheet fullscreen 390x844. No blocking issues.

issues: Console warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby for {DialogContent}' — add SheetDescription or aria-describedby to ClientSheet for a11y.
Pre-existing React hydration errors: <span> nested as child of <table>/<tbody>/<tr> (from x-file-name=QuoteForm ~line 868). Same issue reported in iteration_21 — still present, not blocking.
